result.finding: SLF4J with Logback as the logging framework (provided transitively by Spring Boot starter). All 4 controllers and service classes use SLF4J's LoggerFactory. No APM/telemetry tools, no Spring AOP, no Spring Actuator configured.
evidence: SLF4J (org.slf4j.LoggerFactory) imported in 4 source files: HomeController, DetailController, PhotoFileController, PhotoServiceImpl
Logback provided transitively via spring-boot-starter-web (no explicit logback dependency in pom.xml — Spring Boot auto-configures it)
No logback.xml or log4j2.xml config files — Spring Boot default logback configuration used, customized via application.properties (logging.level.*)
Logging level configured in application.properties: logging.level.com.photoalbum=DEBUG, logging.level.org.springframework.web=DEBUG
No APM agents detected: no Application Insights, New Relic, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry dependencies
No AOP detected: no @Aspect, @Before, @After, @Around annotations; no aspectjweaver in pom.xml
